summary: Patch sympifies string p (and string q) before the numeric path, correctly fixing Rational('0.5','100') → 1/200 by reusing existing SymPy parsing. Sound, minimal, low-risk; only edge-case asymmetry and a comment nit.

issues.description: Only converts q when p is also a str. Cases like Rational(0.5, '100') (float p, str q) are not routed through sympify, so string-q handling stays inconsistent. Not the reported case, but leaves a related edge unaddressed.
Catching SyntaxError alongside SympifyError and silently passing ('error will raise below') is slightly fragile; relies on downstream to re-raise a meaningful error rather than validating here.
New string-coercion block adds a special-case branch at the top of __new__ with no docstring/example note; a brief comment on why strings need pre-sympification would aid maintainability.
